d: Located on the second floor of Polaris Institute’s main hall, it is an internal area of the institute that connects core departments including Aniimology, Pathfinding, and Battle Art.
Built by the lake, it’s the hub of the whole Northside that connects different shopping streets.
Used to track target. Tracking it will be canceled if you start tracking another target. Use this again to re-enable tracking.

A café offering all kinds of coffee and specialty drinks. The Star-Crossed Tea Party runs daily from 18:00 to 02:00, with limited items and special benefits up for grabs. We look forward to your visit!
